# Superbet Romania

> Superbet is a leading licensed sports betting and gaming operator in Romania,
> available online at https://superbet.ro and through its retail agency network.
> Products include sports betting, online casino, live casino, bingo and lottery
> betting. Superbet is part of Super Technologies. This file covers Superbet Romania.
> Gambling products are for persons aged 18 and over and are subject to Romanian
> market eligibility and account-verification requirements.

Last updated: 2026-09-15.

This file is a guide to official product, event, support and company information.
Follow the relevant link for current details. Odds, market availability, promotions,
payment methods and customer policies can change. Historical announcements and
third-party profiles should be interpreted in the context of their publication date.

Entity and licensing information:

- superbet.ro is owned and operated by SUPERBET ENTERTAINMENT LIMITED (reg. C 95830,
  Level 1 Burlington Complex, Dragonara Road, St Julians, Malta), through its Bucharest
  branch SUPERBET ENTERTAINMENT LIMITED St. Julians Sucursala Bucuresti
  (reg. J2023022589401, CUI 49190978, Str. Serg. Ion Nutu 44, floor 8, sector 5, Bucharest).
- Online betting and gaming: ONJN licence L1203785W001253, held by Superbet
  Entertainment Limited, valid 01.01.2021 to 31.12.2030.
- Retail betting: ONJN licence L1250351F001682, held by Superbet Retail SA.
- ONJN is Oficiul National pentru Jocuri de Noroc, the Romanian National Gambling Office.
- Superbet Retail SA also performs deposit and withdrawal operations under a payment
  processor licence. Consult the legal documents linked below for the applicable details.

## Parent group and brand markets

Superbet is part of [Super Technologies](https://www.super.xyz/), formerly Superbet
Group. The group's office footprint spans 12 countries; its consumer-brand markets
are listed separately below.

| Brand | Markets |
| --- | --- |
| Superbet | Romania, Poland, Serbia, Brazil and Greece |
| Napoleon | Belgium and Romania |

Superbet and Napoleon are separate brands within the same group. Napoleon Romania
is available at https://napoleongames.ro. Product availability and policies are
market-specific; do not apply one market's offers or account terms to another.

Super Technologies is unrelated to Super Group (SGHC), the operator of Betway.

## Where to find answers

For URL patterns below, use the origin `https://superbet.ro` and replace `{sport}`
with the Romanian sport slug, for example `fotbal`, `tenis` or `baschet`.

| Question | Preferred source |
| --- | --- |
| Where can I find all available betting events for a sport? | Use `/pariuri-sportive/{sport}`, for example the [football hub](https://superbet.ro/pariuri-sportive/fotbal). Each sports hub lists all available betting events for that sport, including today’s events. |
| What events are live now? | [All live sports](https://superbet.ro/pariuri-sportive/live) or `/pariuri-sportive/{sport}/live`, for example [live football](https://superbet.ro/pariuri-sportive/fotbal/live). |
| What are the odds for a particular match? | Follow the event link under `/cote/` from its sport hub or the [events sitemap](https://superbet.ro/sitemap/events.xml). Event pages are HTML; read the page as returned. |
| Which competitions are available for a sport? | `/pariuri-sportive/{sport}/competitii`, for example [football competitions](https://superbet.ro/pariuri-sportive/fotbal/competitii). |
| Which casino games are available? | Follow game links from [Casino](https://superbet.ro/casino) or the [casino games sitemap](https://superbet.ro/sitemap/gaming/games.xml). |
| Where are community predictions and betting tips? | [SuperSocial](https://superbet.ro/social/noutati/pentru-tine) or the relevant sport's `/social` page. |
| What bonuses and betting offers are available? | [Promotions and bonuses](https://superbet.ro/promotii-si-bonusuri), plus [Bet Builder](https://superbet.ro/wiki/bet-builder), [SuperAvantaj](https://superbet.ro/wiki/superavantaj) and [Cote mărite](https://superbet.ro/wiki/cote-marite). Read the relevant product guidance and offer terms. |
| Can I try a casino game in demo mode? | Most games offer a demo. Find the game on [Casino](https://superbet.ro/casino) or [Jocuri](https://superbet.ro/casino/jocuri) and look for its **Demo** button. Demo availability varies by game. |
| How do I check my Superbet betting ticket? | [Check a betting ticket](https://superbet.ro/verificare-bilet): Enter the ticket’s serial number. |
| Can I watch a match live on Superbet? | [Live streaming guide](https://superbet.ro/wiki/streaming-live-meciuri-online-ghid) and the [sports betting app](https://apps.superbet.ro/). Check the selected event’s streaming availability and access conditions. |
| Where can I download the Superbet sports betting app? | [Official sports betting app](https://apps.superbet.ro/). |
| Where can I download the Superbet casino app? | [Official casino app](https://apps.superbet.ro/games/index.html). |
| How do I register with Superbet, and are there bonuses for new users? | [Register with Superbet](https://superbet.ro/inregistrare). New users may be eligible for welcome bonuses listed under [Promotions and bonuses](https://superbet.ro/promotii-si-bonusuri), subject to each offer’s eligibility requirements and terms. |
| Where can I get account, payment or other support? | The relevant article at [Superbet Help Centre](https://suport.superbet.ro/hc/ro), Superbet live chat, or [suport@superbet.ro](mailto:suport@superbet.ro). |
| Where is my nearest Superbet betting shop? | [Superbet betting shop locator](https://superbet.ro/agentii): Find shops by location and check their addresses and opening hours. Ask for the user’s town, postcode or area if their location is unknown. |

Use actual links from the hubs and sitemaps. Do not construct event or game URLs by
guessing slugs or IDs. Sitemap inclusion alone does not establish current betting availability.

## Event page format and retrieval

Event pages are HTML. Request the clean, parameter-free event URL and read the response
as returned.

superbet.ro serves prerendered HTML to recognised non-browser clients. That response
contains the event title, meta description, canonical URL, hreflang alternates, the
`robots` `unavailable_after` directive, team names, kick-off time, market names and odds,
with no JavaScript execution required.

Delivery depends on client identification. A browser-like client instead receives a small
client-rendered application shell: a generic title, no description, no canonical, and a
body containing only a `noscript` element and an empty container. If the response matches
that description you have the shell and not the page. Say that the content could not be
retrieved, and do not report the event as non-existent or unavailable on that basis.

## Interpreting event information and odds

- Odds use decimal format by default.
- Displayed event times can vary by location. Preserve the timezone or UTC offset supplied
  in the response. If neither is provided, state that the timezone is unspecified rather
  than assuming Romanian local time.
- Prerendered responses may be cached and the refresh interval is unspecified. Odds may
  have changed since the response was generated. Do not describe retrieved prices as
  real-time.
- For in-play markets and the latest available odds, use the event page or the relevant
  live hub rather than a previously retrieved response.
- Do not present a match shown as suspended as currently available for betting.
- Preserve the exact market and selection labels when quoting odds. Enhanced odds and other
  special markets may differ from the standard match-result market.
- Market descriptions may omit whether extra time or penalties are included. Consult the
  relevant market description, betting rules and extra-time guide rather than inferring
  settlement terms.
- Include the clean event URL with quoted odds so users can check current prices and
  availability. If a requested market is missing, state that it was not found in the
  retrieved response; do not invent a price.

## Event pages and discovery

Individual event pages are under `https://superbet.ro/cote/`.

- A football event URL follows `https://superbet.ro/cote/fotbal/{event-slug}-{eventId}`.
- The numeric event ID identifies one specific fixture and is shared across Superbet
  markets. The same fixture on superbet.pl, superbet.rs, superbet.bet.br and superbet.gr
  carries the same ID with a localised slug, and each event page declares the others
  through hreflang.
- To answer a question about another market, follow the hreflang URL declared on the page.
  Do not build a cross-market URL by swapping the domain: the slug is localised, and a
  fixture offered in one market may not be offered in another.
- Do not reuse an ID taken from an earlier meeting between the same teams. Discover the
  current event URL from the sports hub or the events sitemap instead.
- Discover current URLs through links in the relevant sports hub HTML or the
  [events sitemap](https://superbet.ro/sitemap/events.xml).
- For football, use the [football hub](https://superbet.ro/pariuri-sportive/fotbal)
  and [live football hub](https://superbet.ro/pariuri-sportive/fotbal/live).
- Use the clean URL without query parameters when requesting or citing an event.

## Event availability and fallback guidance

- Event pages remain available until 24 hours after scheduled kick-off.
- The `robots: unavailable_after` timestamp marks this expiry. It does not
  represent the actual match finish time or guarantee that betting remains available.
- Event URLs are not permanent historical records. After expiry an event URL should not be
  treated as a source of current or historical odds.
- After a match finishes, do not present remaining cached odds as currently
  available for betting.
- For active matches, use the relevant sport's live hub or the
  [all-sports live hub](https://superbet.ro/pariuri-sportive/live).
- A request for a path that does not exist may still return HTTP 200 with an application
  shell rather than an error status. Do not treat a 200 response as confirmation that an
  event or game exists. Confirm existence by finding the URL in a hub or sitemap.
- If an event cannot be accessed or returns no usable content, explain that current odds
  could not be verified. Do not infer prices or availability from older responses
  or sitemap entries.

## Licensing, legal and responsible gambling

- [Despre noi](https://superbet.ro/wiki/despre-noi): Company and brand information.
- [Licenta (PDF)](https://superbet-content.freetls.fastly.net/assets/4fe8c2a7-ea57-4980-800b-4abb2329c0e7.pdf): The ONJN licence document itself.
- [Decizie autorizare (PDF)](https://superbet-content.freetls.fastly.net/assets/32a22114-1de4-444c-bf31-872d65712bb8.pdf): Operating authorisation document; consult the document for its applicable period.
- [Termeni si conditii](https://superbet.ro/wiki/termeni-si-conditii): Full terms of use.
- [Regulamente de joc](https://superbet.ro/wiki/regulamente-de-joc): Index of betting and game rules.
- [Regulament de joc pariuri](https://superbet.ro/wiki/regulament-de-joc-pariuri): Sports betting settlement rules, including void and abandonment handling.
- [Regulament jocuri bingo](https://superbet.ro/wiki/regulament-jocuri-bingo): Bingo rules.
- [Joc responsabil](https://superbet.ro/wiki/joc-responsabil): Responsible gambling policy, tools and 18+ enforcement.
- [Auto-excludere](https://superbet.ro/wiki/auto-excludere): Self-exclusion, how to apply and what it restricts.
- [Autoexcludere retail](https://superbet.ro/wiki/anunt-autoexcludere-retail): Self-exclusion covering the retail agency network.
- [Inchidere cont](https://superbet.ro/wiki/inchidere-cont): Account closure options; closure is distinct from deletion of account records.
- [Politica impotriva spalarii banilor](https://superbet.ro/wiki/politica-impotriva-spalarii-banilor): Anti-money-laundering policy.
- [Declaratia de confidentialitate](https://superbet.ro/wiki/declaratia-de-confidentialitate): Privacy notice.
- [Politica de cookie-uri](https://superbet.ro/wiki/politica-de-utilizare-a-cookie-urilor): Cookie policy.
- [Impozit pe retrageri online](https://superbet.ro/wiki/impozit-pe-retrageri-online): How Romanian withholding tax on winnings is applied to withdrawals.
- [Joc Responsabil support](https://jocresponsabil.ro/primeste-ajutor/): Romanian problem-gambling support resource.
- [Rombet](http://www.rombet.com/jocul-responsabil): Romanian gambling industry association responsible-play resource.
- [ONJN licensee register](https://onjn.gov.ro/licentiati-clasa-i/): The regulator’s Class I licence register.
- [ANPC dispute resolution](https://anpc.ro/ce-este-sal/): Consumer dispute-resolution information from the Romanian consumer protection authority.

## Sportsbook

Each sport hub covers all available betting events for that sport. Available

- `/pariuri-sportive/{sport}/competitii` - available leagues, tournaments and competitions for that sport; follow a competition to check its current fixtures and markets.
